## 02 // SELECTED WORK (12 PRODUCTION AI PROJECTS)

01. **24/7 WhatsApp Rental & Service Booking AI Agent**
    - Highlight: Voice Notes + PDF Quote & Receipt
    - Description: Handles voice notes, sends fleet photos, generates instant PDF quotes, and issues verified booking receipts 24/7.
    - Stack: FastAPI, LangChain, WhatsApp API

02. **SBP Monetary Policy — Context-Aware Financial RAG**
    - Highlight: Docling + Qdrant + Cohere Rerank
    - Description: Preserves complex central bank financial tables via Docling with hybrid Qdrant retrieval and verbatim inline citations.
    - Stack: Docling, Qdrant, FastAPI

03. **Claude External Memory MCP Server**
    - Highlight: 70% Token Cost Reduction
    - Description: Gives Claude persistent cross-session memory while cutting token consumption by 70% via selective context injection.
    - Stack: MCP, Claude API, Python

04. **Lahore Smog Watch — Live Air Quality AI Agent**
    - Highlight: WAQI + NASA FIRMS + Open-Meteo
    - Description: Fuses live station maps, 7-day forecasts, and NASA satellite crop-fire telemetry into plain-language advisories.
    - Stack: LangGraph, FastAPI, NASA FIRMS

05. **Bird Voice AI — 10-Species Audio Classification**
    - Highlight: 82.4% Unseen Test Accuracy
    - Description: Transfer learning pipeline using Google YAMNet across 2,100 augmented spectrograms, deployed on HuggingFace.
    - Stack: TensorFlow, YAMNet, Librosa

06. **Pakistan Federal Budget Bilingual AI RAG**
    - Highlight: 160+ Pages · English & Urdu
    - Description: Turns 160+ Federal Budget pages into a bilingual English/Urdu assistant using Parent-Document Retrieval on Pinecone.
    - Stack: LangChain, Pinecone, Cerebras

07. **Job Lead Converter B2B MCP Server**
    - Highlight: Automated Lead Enrichment
    - Description: Scrapes hiring signals, enriches company firmographics, and surfaces verified decision-maker contacts automatically.
    - Stack: MCP, Agentic AI, Python

08. **Real Estate Conversational Property RAG**
    - Highlight: 24/7 Conversational Discovery
    - Description: Enables buyers and renters to search and compare property listings naturally via Jina AI embeddings and Qdrant.
    - Stack: Qdrant, Jina AI, Chainlit

09. **Multi-Agent Content Pipeline — CrewAI**
    - Highlight: 3 Hours -> 60 Seconds
    - Description: Two-agent CrewAI pipeline where a Researcher agent gathers live web stats and a Writer agent drafts posts in 60s.
    - Stack: CrewAI, Groq LLM, Python

10. **Writing Style Cloning Agent — Agno + Pinecone**
    - Highlight: Voyage AI + Pinecone Memory
    - Description: Extracts tone, cadence, and vocabulary from 3-5 writing samples into persistent Pinecone style vectors.
    - Stack: Agno, Pinecone, Voyage AI

11. **Autonomous CSV Data Analyst — LangGraph**
    - Highlight: CSV -> Live Charts -> PDF Report
    - Description: Routes plain-English questions over uploaded CSVs to specialist Analyst and Chart Generator agents with PDF export.
    - Stack: LangGraph, Streamlit, Matplotlib

12. **Zero-Framework ReAct Agent & Glaucoma Few-Shot Vision**
    - Highlight: PyTorch U-Net + MAML Meta-Learning
    - Description: First-principles Python ReAct agent paired with clinical glaucoma optic-disc segmentation via U-Net and MAML.
    - Stack: PyTorch, U-Net & MAML, Python
